title: Bristlebind
summary: Bristlebind is a spell that causes a number of thorny vines to grow out of the ground and then wrap around an opposing target. These vines not only cause damage due to the thorns but also restrict movement. It is manifested initially as a beam of red energy on the Seeker's hand, which then produces the vines. The vines can either be projected directly from the beam or from a surface with which the beam makes contact.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Bristlebind was used by Dante Vale to bind the legs of Ymir in search of the Temple of Thor. The giant Titan tumbled but was able to get up after a few seconds, giving the Huntik team some time to get away from it. [The Legacy of Thor]

Dante Vale used the spell in an attempt to slow down Grier when they were fighting one-on-one in Sutos Island. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

On the Huntik team's way to the Golden Asp, Lok Lambert used Bristlebind in combination with Zhalia Moon's Darkfog spell to flip an Organization car who was following them multiple times. Darkfog made it so the driver couldn't see the incoming vines. [The Golden Asp]

Marduk also used this spell to ensnare Dante Vale's Metagolem in Mexico during the search for the Ring of Quetzalcoatl. Metagolem struggled for a short moment, but he was quickly able to break the vines and take out an Harlekin Titan attacking him. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Lane used Bristlebind to restrain one of many Silent Soldiers in a massive war against the Blood Spirals by the Fortress of Iron Will.[The Spiral War]

This spell was used by Dante Vale in conjunction with Stopglue to heavily detain Hoffman when the two were fighting in The Professor's Castle. [An Ally from the Organization]

Scarlet Byrne used Bristlebind to bind the legs of a Firbolg Titan the Huntik team encountered when exploring Tír na nÓg. This allowed Sophie Casterwill and Kaioh the Tracker to freely strike the Titan, taking him out. [Back Home]
